coverage.text: Every requirement maps to a model row, a task and a gate row.

findings.text: The operator settled the receipt wording with one self-contained receipt, and the texts outside the fence stay for a follow-up. The ledger seam is verified first. The book's condition is enforced by CI until the book is derived. The deployed-trace premise is checked by the first devnet run. Reasons are compared verbatim with Lean's. The denominator now holds every live refusal, and the phase-one reject conflict is an epic-owned hold. Review one found that differing or unobserved reasons left no record and the accepting control had no failing check; both are repaired. Review two found that a label could exempt a compared refusal; class A is now a fact the runner records.

terminology.text: Chain-side reason means the admitted traced reason only, unobserved always names its cause, and an attribution row says nothing about Lean.

size.text: Artifact sizes are measured at commit; the plan stays under two hundred lines.
